mapper.select: SELECT p.*, u.nick_name AS author_name, u.user_name AS author_user_name, d.dept_name, t.title AS topic_title, IF(p.update_time IS NOT NULL AND p.update_time > p.create_time,1,0) AS edited FROM biz_research_post p JOIN biz_research_topic t ON t.topic_id=p.topic_id AND t.del_flag='0' LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id=p.author_id LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON d.dept_id=p.dept_id WHERE p.post_id=#{postId} AND p.del_flag='0'
SELECT * FROM biz_research_post WHERE post_id=#{postId}
SELECT * FROM biz_research_post WHERE post_id=#{postId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT p.*, u.nick_name AS author_name, u.user_name AS author_user_name, d.dept_name, t.title AS topic_title, IF(p.update_time IS NOT NULL AND p.update_time > p.create_time,1,0) AS edited FROM biz_research_post p JOIN biz_research_topic t ON t.topic_id=p.topic_id AND t.del_flag='0' LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id=p.author_id LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON d.dept_id=p.dept_id WHERE p.topic_id=#{topicId} AND p.del_flag='0' AND p.post_type=#{postType} ORDER BY (p.post_type='RESOURCE' AND p.is_pinned='Y') DESC, p.create_time DESC, p.post_id DESC

SELECT p.*, u.nick_name AS author_name, u.user_name AS author_user_name, d.dept_name, t.title AS topic_title, IF(p.update_time IS NOT NULL AND p.update_time > p.create_time,1,0) AS edited FROM biz_research_post p JOIN biz_research_topic t ON t.topic_id=p.topic_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id=p.author_id LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON d.dept_id=p.dept_id WHERE p.del_flag='2' ORDER BY p.update_time DESC,p.post_id DESC

SELECT p.*, u.nick_name AS author_name, u.user_name AS author_user_name, d.dept_name, t.title AS topic_title, IF(p.update_time IS NOT NULL AND p.update_time > p.create_time,1,0) AS edited FROM biz_research_post p JOIN biz_research_topic t ON t.topic_id=p.topic_id AND t.del_flag='0' LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id=p.author_id LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON d.dept_id=p.dept_id WHERE p.del_flag='0' AND p.post_type='RESOURCE' AND p.school_type=#{schoolType} AND p.grade=#{grade} AND p.semester=#{semester} AND p.lesson_kind=#{lessonKind} AND p.lesson_no=#{lessonNo} AND p.author_id=#{authorId} AND p.create_time >= #{beginTime} AND p.create_time <= #{endTime}
AND (p.course_title LIKE #{keywordLike} ESCAPE '!' OR t.title LIKE #{keywordLike} ESCAPE '!' OR p.content_text LIKE #{keywordLike} ESCAPE '!' OR u.nick_name LIKE #{keywordLike} ESCAPE '!')
ORDER BY p.is_pinned DESC,
CASE WHEN p.course_title=#{keyword} THEN 0 WHEN p.course_title LIKE #{keywordPrefix} ESCAPE '!' THEN 1 WHEN p.course_title LIKE #{keywordLike} ESCAPE '!' THEN 2 WHEN t.title LIKE #{keywordLike} ESCAPE '!' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END ASC,
COALESCE(p.update_time,p.create_time) DESC, p.post_id DESC

mapper.update: UPDATE biz_research_resource SET access_count=access_count+1 WHERE resource_id=#{resourceId} AND del_flag='0'
mapper.sql: FROM sys_user u JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.user_id=u.user_id JOIN sys_role r ON r.role_id=ur.role_id AND r.role_key='teacher' AND r.status='0' AND r.del_flag='0' LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON d.dept_id=u.dept_id WHERE u.status='0' AND u.del_flag='0'

SELECT DISTINCT u.user_id,u.nick_name,u.user_name,u.phonenumber,u.dept_id,d.dept_name,d.school_type
AND (d.school_type=#{schoolType} OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_dept ud JOIN sys_dept md ON md.dept_id=ud.dept_id AND md.del_flag='0' AND md.status='0' WHERE ud.user_id=u.user_id AND md.school_type=#{schoolType} ))
AND (u.nick_name LIKE #{keywordLike} ESCAPE '!' OR u.user_name LIKE #{keywordLike} ESCAPE '!' OR u.phonenumber LIKE #{keywordLike} ESCAPE '!' OR d.dept_name LIKE #{keywordLike} ESCAPE '!' OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_dept ud JOIN sys_dept md ON md.dept_id=ud.dept_id AND md.del_flag='0' WHERE ud.user_id=u.user_id AND md.dept_name LIKE #{keywordLike} ESCAPE '!' ))
ORDER BY d.dept_name ASC,u.nick_name ASC,u.user_id ASC

SELECT DISTINCT u.user_id,u.nick_name,u.user_name,u.phonenumber,u.dept_id,d.dept_name, COALESCE(( SELECT MIN(md.school_type) FROM sys_user_dept ud JOIN sys_dept md ON md.dept_id=ud.dept_id AND md.del_flag='0' AND md.status='0' WHERE ud.user_id=u.user_id AND md.school_type IN #{stage} ),d.school_type) AS school_type
AND (d.school_type IN #{stage} OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_dept ud JOIN sys_dept md ON md.dept_id=ud.dept_id AND md.del_flag='0' AND md.status='0' WHERE ud.user_id=u.user_id AND md.school_type IN #{stage} )) ORDER BY u.user_id ASC

SELECT DISTINCT u.user_id,u.nick_name,u.user_name,u.phonenumber,u.dept_id,d.dept_name,d.school_type
AND u.user_id IN #{userId} ORDER BY u.user_id ASC
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO biz_research_notice_recipient (topic_id,user_id,source_type,source_value,notice_level,read_flag,read_time,notify_time, create_by,create_time,update_by,update_time) VALUES
(#{item.topicId},#{item.userId},#{item.sourceType},#{item.sourceValue},#{item.noticeLevel}, 'N',NULL,#{item.notifyTime},#{item.createBy},#{item.createTime},#{item.updateBy},#{item.updateTime})
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE source_type=VALUES(source_type), source_value=VALUES(source_value), notice_level=VALUES(notice_level), read_flag='N', read_time=NULL, notify_time=VALUES(notify_time), update_by=VALUES(update_by), update_time=VALUES(update_time)
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM biz_research_notice_recipient n JOIN biz_research_topic t ON t.topic_id=n.topic_id AND t.del_flag='0' WHERE n.user_id=#{userId} AND n.read_flag='N' AND (t.activity_time IS NULL OR t.activity_time > NOW())

SELECT n.recipient_id,n.topic_id,t.title AS topic_title,n.notice_level,n.read_flag, t.activity_time,n.read_time,n.notify_time,u.nick_name AS creator_name FROM biz_research_notice_recipient n JOIN biz_research_topic t ON t.topic_id=n.topic_id AND t.del_flag='0' LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id=t.creator_id WHERE n.user_id=#{userId} AND ((t.activity_time IS NULL AND n.read_flag='N') OR t.activity_time > NOW()) ORDER BY CASE WHEN t.activity_time IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ASC, t.activity_time ASC,n.notify_time DESC,n.recipient_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT n.recipient_id,n.topic_id,t.title AS topic_title,n.notice_level,n.read_flag, t.activity_time,n.read_time,n.notify_time,u.nick_name AS creator_name FROM biz_research_notice_recipient n JOIN biz_research_topic t ON t.topic_id=n.topic_id AND t.del_flag='0' LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id=t.creator_id WHERE n.user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY n.read_flag ASC,n.notify_time DESC,n.recipient_id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE biz_research_notice_recipient SET read_flag='Y',read_time=COALESCE(read_time,NOW()),update_time=NOW() WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND read_flag='N'
